chapters.title: The Underwater Cave
chapters.description: The blue stone is hidden inside an underwater cave, in an Amazonian forest.
chapters.story_text: You start swimming inside the lake, and soon you encounter a few dolphins.

choices.text: Pretend you are just here for a nice relaxing dive and move forward

result.message: You passed them, you found the cave and you enter it

choices.text: Greet them and tell them what you are searching for

result.message: They became hostile when they found out you want the stone. You die.

choices.text: Ask them to help you in your journey to acquire the Blue Stone

result.message: They helped you find the stone, and then they kill you to take it for themselves. You die.

chapters.title: The Water Elemental
chapters.description: Inside the cave, there is a water elemental that protects the Blue Stone.
chapters.story_text: He asks you why you are trying to steal the Blue Stone.

choices.text: Kill the elemental and take the Blue Stone

result.message: You die, the elemental was more powerful than you!

choices.text: Tell him that you are not stealing, you are helping Red to rescue Bart from the evil Skull

result.message: The elemental agrees to help you yeah he knows Bart very well!

choices.text: Tell him that you need that stone to save someone and you will give the stone back once you finish your quest

result.message: The elemental thinks you are lying to him, you fight for a while, but in the end, you die

chapters.title: The Elemental's Offer
chapters.description: The elemental offers his help to save Bart.

choices.text: Yes, we need all the help we can get
No, You should guard this place when we return with the stone, we don't want robbers to be here!

result.message: The elemental agrees, he will remain at his station
